rows.note: For food or drink preserved in a can, 罐裝 is the all-purpose adjective, as in 罐裝番茄.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 maai5 gun3 zong1 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use 老套 when “canned” means unoriginal, predictable, or formulaic rather than physically preserved in a can.

example.english: Your marriage-proposal routine is too canned.
example.traditional: 你個求婚橋段太老套喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 kau4 fan1 kiu4 dyun6 taai3 lou5 tou3 laa3
